design.name: 蛮蛮
design.brief: The Manman (蛮蛮) birds of Chongwu Mountain in the Shan Hai Jing, 'shaped like a wild duck, each with only one wing and one eye, they can fly only when paired': stout cartoon wild-duck-like birds about 0.9 m tall. Each bird has only ONE wing and ONE single big glowing violet eye in the middle of its face (weak spot); slate-blue and rust feathers carved as big clumps, orange bill and webbed feet. Main pose: the PAIR flying side by side (the left bird has only a left wing, the right bird only a right wing, mirror images), joined wing-tip to wing-tip by a short solid sculpted magenta lightning bar. Front, side and back views: ONE bird alone, the one with a left wing only.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing on its two webbed feet like a duck, the body upright, the head facing straight ahead with the bill closed; it has ONLY ONE WING, on the bird's own LEFT side, spread out horizontally to the side, straight and level with the flight feathers fanned; its RIGHT side has NO wing at all, just a smooth feathered flank; the single big eye in the middle of its face painted as an opaque bright violet disc (no halo); the short tail pointing straight back; NO lightning bar (that is an effect between two birds)
design.turnaround_digits: each webbed foot with three separate toes joined by webbing; the whole spread wing fully inside the frame (it is widest in the front and back views, keep generous margin).
